scope: Parameters only for Codex1's guarded step-4 packet (the guard, launcher and binder in packet_read, unchanged): root copies route_a_admission into C1 cfg.route_a_admission and caps_per_case into cfg.caps (ROOT_CAPS_BINDING). No packet code changes. The packet's memory check stays memory_pressure >= 25 % (MEASURED blind: 85-86 % free at 83 GB of run footprint), so max_active is the only memory lever: the largest value whose random-phase rows meet the campaign criteria (time above 83 GB <= 0.1 %, peak < 110 GB, time above 72 GB <= 2 %) in the expected and all-32-iteration rows. HEADLINE and SENS at 3 reach 130.5 GB and at 2 spend 0.17-0.63 % above 83 GB (SIM_S45_C2V002), so both are 1 until the packet runs on machine_gate_s45_c2v002. A direct batch must not start while the campaign or the NGC loop has calls running (the packet does not count them).
